comment: SPEC.md §11.1.2: `hdfs dfs -count -q -v` prints eight columns — QUOTA, REM_QUOTA, SPACE_QUOTA, REM_SPACE_QUOTA, DIR_COUNT, FILE_COUNT, CONTENT_SIZE, PATHNAME — and with no quota set the two QUOTA columns read `none` and the two REM_ columns read `inf`. An empty prefix reports zero in all three count columns, so a parser looking for a percentage string, or for a number in a `none` column, finds neither.
stdout:
QUOTA       REM_QUOTA     SPACE_QUOTA REM_SPACE_QUOTA    DIR_COUNT   FILE_COUNT       CONTENT_SIZE PATHNAME
        none             inf            none             inf            0            0                  0 /warehouse
